cast.name: Hana
cast.description: Hana Kurose, 19, rookie pilot of Ashgull; a stubborn, quick, over-apologising dockhand from Tanabe Salvage
visual_tags: short choppy black bob with one orange hair clip
faded orange-and-grey flight suit with taped knees
work gloves clipped to her belt
slim build, determined wide eyes

cast.name: Gen
cast.description: Gen Tanabe, 56, gruff owner and chief mechanic of Tanabe Salvage; Hana's mentor
visual_tags: grey buzz cut and thick grey moustache
oil-stained navy mechanic coveralls, sleeves rolled
towel around his neck
stocky broad build, always holding a wrench

cast.name: PIPPA
cast.description: Ashgull's cheerful, literal salvaged onboard AI; appears only as a face on the cockpit dashboard screen
visual_tags: small rectangular dashboard screen
simple glowing face: two round dots and a line mouth
soft cyan screen glow
no body

cast.name: Yui
cast.description: Yui Kanzaki, 20, Kanzaki Marine Security ace pilot and company heir; precise, proud rival
visual_tags: long straight silver-white hair in a high ponytail
fitted white-and-teal pilot suit
narrow calm eyes
tall upright posture, arms often crossed

mechs.name: Ashgull
mechs.description: Hana's decades-old harbour-defence frame rebuilt from salvage; chunky, heavy and deliberate, about 18 metres tall
visual_tags: dull grey riveted plating with faded safety-orange forearm stripes
one mismatched replacement shoulder plate
single wide visor slit with soft amber glow
winch and harpoon cable on the right forearm
chest work floodlights, broad boxy shoulders

mechs.name: Halcyon
mechs.description: Yui's modern Kanzaki Marine Security frame; slimmer, faster and always spotless
visual_tags: clean white-and-teal plating
smooth rounded head with twin horizontal sensor lines
folding shield on the left arm
pneumatic lance on the right arm
slim agile silhouette
